stories.text: As the operator, I want the identity product rebuilt on the hardened Rauthy release to start on data the previous release wrote, so that the upgrade needs no migration run by hand.

personas.name: Fork maintainer
personas.role: Keeps the ablative branch of the Rauthy fork

stories.text: As the fork maintainer, I want our commits to sit unaltered on top of the upstream release tag, so that a diff against the tag shows only our work by name.

As the fork maintainer, I want ablative to move only after its new head is green, with its previous head kept under a tag, so that ablative never sits on a failing head and every earlier lys pin still resolves.
As the reviewer, I want the trigger recorded as facts in the pull request, so that whether the card may start is checked rather than judged.
As the reviewer, I want the account-status, redirect and logout guards proved at the release tag, so that a release without the hardening can never be taken as the base.

personas.name: Person
personas.role: Signs in with two linked providers

stories.text: As a person who linked two sign-in providers, I want both to still resolve to me after the rebase, so that the upgrade never splits my identity.
